description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService class, which provides methods for managing employee immigration records in the OrangeHRM system. It acts as a service layer that interacts with the data access object (DAO) to retrieve, save, delete, and search immigration records.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to interact with employee immigration records, utilizing DAO for database operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance for employee immigration records, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: setEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for employee immigration records.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific immigration record for an employee based on employee number and record number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves all immigration records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves an employee immigration record; can be used for creating or updating records.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple immigration records for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a search for immigration records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter criteria.
